vignette: Kai had always taken pride in his work as a plumber, but after the abuse he suffered at the hands of his partner, even the familiar scent of solder and flux couldn't shake off the feeling of unease. It started with the smell of burnt food, reminiscent of the night his partner's anger boiled over into violence. The kitchen had been filled with the acrid smell of burnt meat as Kai cowered on the floor, hands raised in a futile attempt to deflect the blows. Ever since, the slightest whiff of something burnt would transport him back to that moment, and he'd find himself recoiling, as if expecting the same punishment all over again. Confrontations with his partner had always been intense, but after the abuse, even calm discussions about whose turn it was to do the dishes could escalate into full-blown arguments. Kai's partner would express anger in a low, measured tone, and Kai would freeze, unsure how to respond without triggering another outburst. These days, even witnessing others expressing anger – whether in person or on TV – made him squirm with discomfort. To cope with these constant reminders of his trauma, Kai had developed some maladaptive strategies. He'd find himself delaying sleep until the early hours, lying awake as his mind replayed every confrontation and argument from the past few months. He convinced himself that if he could just stay vigilant enough, he might be able to prevent another incident. But this came at a cost – he'd often show up late to work, bleary-eyed, and struggle to focus on even the simplest tasks. Thinking about the event itself was something Kai tried to avoid altogether. He wouldn't dare approach the site of the abuse – their old apartment – for fear of being overwhelmed by memories. Instead, he'd take circuitous routes home from work or visit friends who lived in different neighborhoods. But despite these efforts, fragments of that night continued to seep into his waking life. One day, while working on a particularly tricky pipe fix, Kai's coworker let out a loud curse as a wrench slipped and clattered to the floor. The sudden outburst sent Kai reeling – he hastily packed up his tools and excused himself, unable to shake off the feeling of unease that lingered long after the job was finished. As time went on, these avoidance behaviors began to take a toll on Kai's relationships with those around him. His wife grew concerned about his increasingly erratic work schedule, and friends started to notice his tendency to disappear whenever conversations turned heated. But for Kai, these strategies were necessary survival tools – without them, he felt like he'd be exposing himself to the same kind of danger all over again. It was only when Kai's boss threatened to terminate him due to his chronic tardiness that he realized just how far things had spiraled out of control. Faced with the prospect of losing his livelihood and struggling to make ends meet, Kai finally sought help – hoping against hope that therapy might be able to untangle the web of fear and avoidance that had come to define his life.
